industries.title: 航空航天与国防
industries.subtitle: Aerospace & Defense Solutions
painpoints: 传统复材为平面层合结构，受强冲击或交变载荷时，层与层之间极易发生分层剥离，导致突发性断裂失效。
大飞机机身肋梁、发动机喷管、火箭整流罩等复杂双曲率异型构件，手工铺贴难度极大，纤维排列难以保证精准一致。
变截面中空结构件如果采用传统缠绕工艺，纤维在倾斜角较陡的面容易滑脱，难以保证轴向力学性能。
painpointsEn: Traditional composites use planar laminated structures that are highly prone to interlayer delamination under strong impact or alternating loads, causing sudden fracture failure.

Complex double-curvature components such as large aircraft fuselage ribs, engine nozzles, 和 rocket fairings are extremely difficult to manually lay up, making it hard to ensure precise 和 consistent fiber alignment.
Variable cross-section hollow structural components using traditional winding processes are prone to fiber slippage on steep inclines, making it difficult to ensure axial mechanical performance.
industries.solution: 高倍公司利用自主开发的「三维环形与多轴立体编织」工艺，使纤维直接在XYZ三向交叉咬合，从物理结构上消除分层面，材料抗分层剪切强度相比传统铺层工艺提升一倍以上。配合六轴机器人与自适应异形芯模进给系统，能一次性整体编织成形火箭变截面喷管、大口径导风筒及双曲面大承力肋梁预制体，纱线排列角度偏差小于1°。
industries.solutionEn: Gaobei utilizes its independently developed '3D annular 和 multi-axis braiding' process to directly cross-interlock fibers in XYZ three directions, physically eliminating delamination planes 和 improving anti-delamination shear strength by more than double compared to traditional lay-up processes. Combined with six-axis robots 和 adaptive profiled mandrel feeding systems, it can braid rocket variable-section nozzles, large-diameter wind ducts, 和 double-curved high-load rib beam preforms in one step, with yarn alignment angle deviation less than 1°.

industries.title: 新能源与清洁能源
industries.subtitle: New Energy & Power Solutions
painpoints: 70MPa车载车载储氢气瓶在超高压运行下，传统纤维缠绕层层间剪切强度弱，微裂纹极易沿层间扩展导致疲劳泄漏。
大型风力发电机叶片长度突破百米，叶片根部法兰连接部位受力极度集中，传统多层叠合螺栓连接极易在剪力作用下脆断。
特种超高压储能容器在缠绕合拢阶段，丝束张力不均会导致应力集中，发生突发性爆炸风险。
painpointsEn: 70MPa onboard hydrogen storage cylinders operating under ultra-high pressure have weak interlayer shear strength in traditional fiber winding layers, with micro-cracks easily propagating along interlayers causing fatigue leakage.

Large wind turbine blade lengths exceeding 100 meters, with extremely concentrated stress at the blade root flange connections, making traditional multi-layer bolted connections prone to brittle fracture under shear.
Special ultra-high-pressure energy storage vessels experience uneven filament tension during winding closure, causing stress concentration 和 sudden explosion risks.
industries.solution: 我们为储氢瓶内胆定制开发多向混合三维立体外编织方案，编织层不仅具有高环向强度，其特有的厚度向连接纤维能牢牢锁住内部衬里，大幅延缓应力开裂。针对风电叶片根部连接，提供大厚度（＞50mm）整体交织预制体，通过拉挤与三维一体织造技术提升法兰受力部位的结构疲劳寿命，实现全生命周期高安全服役。
industries.solutionEn: We custom-develop multi-directional hybrid 3D outer braiding solutions for hydrogen tank liners. The braiding layer not only has high circumferential strength, but its unique thickness-direction connecting fibers firmly lock the inner liner, significantly delaying stress cracking. For wind blade root connections, we provide large-thickness (>50mm) integral interlaced preforms, using pultrusion 和 3D integral braiding technology to improve the structural fatigue life of flange stress areas for full lifecycle high-safety service.

industries.title: 汽车轻量化与高性能赛车
industries.subtitle: Automotive Lightweighting
painpoints: 新能源乘用车电池包底座及防撞梁要求高吸能、高抗撞，常规钢制件过重，而传统多层手工复材成本高、易崩碎。
传动轴、拉杆等高速扭转长管件，传统层合或缠绕工艺的纤维层抗扭剪性能不够强，超高负荷下极易分层拧断。
乘用车供应链对零部件交付节拍（Tact Time）要求极苛刻，传统手工或半自动复材工艺成型周期动辄以小时计，无法满足流水线装配。
painpointsEn: New energy passenger vehicle battery pack bases 和 crash beams require high energy absorption 和 impact resistance. Conventional steel parts are too heavy, while traditional multi-layer hand-laid composites are costly 和 prone to shattering.

High-speed torsional long tubes like driveshafts 和 tie rods have insufficient torsional shear resistance with traditional lamination or winding processes, easily delaminating 和 breaking under ultra-high loads.

Passenger vehicle supply chains have extremely strict tact time requirements for parts delivery. Traditional manual or semi-automatic composite processes take hours per cycle, unable to meet assembly line pace.
industries.solution: 高倍公司为乘用车底盘拉杆、传动轴、A柱/B柱防撞横梁开发「全自动多轴连续编织注塑一体化」流水线。系统在数字孪生模型精确调度下，纤维编织可在几分钟内完成并由协作机械臂直接送入高速树脂真空辅助浸注热压机（HP-RTM）。构件整体吸能效率达到钢制件的4倍以上，重量减轻30%~50%，良品率稳定在99.2%以上，完美融入汽车大批量生产节奏。
industries.solutionEn: Gaobei has developed a 'fully automated multi-axis continuous braiding-injection integrated' production line for passenger vehicle chassis tie rods, driveshafts, 和 A/B-pillar crash beams. Under precise digital twin model scheduling, fiber braiding can be completed within minutes 和 directly fed into high-speed resin vacuum-assisted injection HP-RTM by collaborative robotic arms. Component overall energy absorption efficiency is 4x that of steel parts, with 30%~50% weight reduction, yield rate stable above 99.2%, perfectly integrating into automotive mass production rhythm.
